problems: Blind guess (giraffe, long legs, head raised top right) does not match the intended goat. The drawn figure has a short neck and a boxy, stool-like body, and the legs are not long. The nearest blind alternative, a deer or antelope, is closer than the giraffe guess. A viewer would not read this as a goat.
The silhouette is a rectangular box with a thin neck stub. It has no beard, no clear chest bulge, and no recognisable goat head shape. The head is tiny relative to the body.

The horn stars are not drawn as horns. The back-swept horn tip (45038 area, star 46977 at about (304,126)) is a free-floating stick line to the head, and the forward horn tip (star 44390 at about (376,160)) sits almost on top of the head. Neither reads as a curved horn sweeping back over the neck.
Belly star 46733 at about (333,270) sits inside the body on the left side, not on the underside of the barrel. The underside of the body is near y 285 across x 300-385.
Hind hoof star 47965 at about (310,404) floats above the foot instead of at the top of the rear hoof. The hoof bottom is near y 425.

Only two legs are drawn as a solid column pair. The hind leg star 48319 at about (292,363) sits on the outer left leg, which is acceptable, but the legs are short and stubby, and the gap between them is too narrow to read as four legs.

Gold lines run as straight sticks across the figure and are not part of the silhouette. The blue outline is a separate shape, so the gold lines are not a copy of the silhouette, which is good. The labels overlap and are truncated at the frame edge, e.g. 'head of the goat (centre of' and 'chest (front edge of the che'.
The figure is right way up. It stands upright with the head at top right, as intended.
